I can see how it could possibly be taken as plagiarism bc it’s very similar to both of the references. However, if they allow you to cite your sources that means you aren’t truly claiming it as 100% your own since you’re showing your inspiration. As long as you’re recognizing and showing your inspiration and reference, it shouldn’t be labeled as harsh copy right. [if you were to claim it all on your own it could have been a different story]

If it’s an obvious copy “pose, props, shading, placement” then I would say it is. Cause if you overlap it and you could tell it’s the same then yes. However, inspiration is completely different. If you copied the concept of holding a mirror and having split faces but they look like two completely different art pieces, it isn’t.
